column1: # hw-coverage (hw-qwen), 2026-10-15: how much of each handwritten page Vision finds as lines, on the truth set's 19 handwritten and 2 mixed pages (HW-PAGES-2026-10-15.tsv).
# Each page through the app's own route (Tools/score-gate.swift's harness taking images, plain Vision, its own defaults domain; built from b086458's Sources).
# The truth has no word positions, so coverage was judged two ways. visual_*: a subagent looked at each page with Vision's lines drawn over it and counted the sheet's text lines,
# covered (about 80% of their words inside a box), partial, missed, and estimated the share of words inside a box (word_share, to 5%). Visual estimates, not measurements.

# vision_lines: the text layer's lines (PDFKit selectionsByLine). ink_share: share of dark pixels (under 0.7 of the local mean and 160/255, 2% margin left out) inside some text-layer line box padded by a quarter of its height.

# Measured, but NOT usable: a dark background or binder rings counts as uncovered ink (p022 0.48 against 70% by eye) and faint pencil hardly counts as ink (p094 0.07 against 25%). Kept for the record.

# Totals by eye: 503 lines, 392 covered (78%), 64 partial, 47 missed; words inside a box about 82% (weighted by lines). Vision itself misses 561 per 1,000 words, so most of its misses are misreadings of lines it found.
